doc: Non-default GenParams (shield_ramp 0.1, shield_texture 0.6, cumulus_max 0.8, cumulus_depth 0.5, a_fine 1.4): every parameter is read from prm, none is a constant. Pipeline dtypes; tolerance is 3x the golden float32 default (the larger a_fine and the narrower ramp 0.1 amplify the roundings). Arguments: s, fine, t, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted t, streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads (the others keep their defaults). params.result_dtype ("f64" or "f32") is the dtype numpy gives the result by promotion (a float64 t array or float64 inputs give f64, a python-float t with float32 fields keeps f32); it is informational, the stored output has that dtype. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 9.6e-8; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 2.4e-6 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 13x the larger of the two spreads.
